chapter.title: Process synchronization
chapter.para: Processes of a partition synchronize with the help of critical sections of the partition's library (called msections), which are managed in the memory of the partition, and enter the kernel only when they have to wait or to wake up another process.

section.para: JetOS shall, when a process wants to enter a critical section that another process of its partition owns, run the owner until it has left the section, so that the processes do not wait for each other for ever.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The owner inherits the urgency of the waiting process, which prevents priority inversion.

section.para: JetOS shall give the processor back to the highest priority process of the partition when the owner of a critical section has left it for a process that wanted to enter it.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The owner runs in place of the waiting process only for as long as it holds the section.

section.para: JetOS shall let the owner of a critical section release it and wait, with a time-out, until another process of the partition wakes it up.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: This is the wait of a process on a condition that another one changes inside the section.

section.para: JetOS shall make the owner of a critical section that waited in it enter the section again when it wakes up.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: This is the wait of a process on a condition that another one changes inside the section.

section.para: JetOS shall let the owner of a critical section wake up one or all of the processes that wait on it, and tell how many there are.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The owner announces the change of the condition.

section.para: JetOS shall let a partition ask the kernel to choose the process to run again after a change that it made in its own memory, such as leaving a critical section.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel does not see the changes that are made in user space.

section.para: JetOS shall delay the stop of a process that is in a critical section until it leaves it, and let the process that asked for the stop wait meanwhile.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A stop in a critical section would block the others for ever.
